decision: Default native simulator sessions to 65,536 semantic steps per host quantum (MegaPad a649f32); keep 8,192 for the Python reference executor.
limitations: The host was shared with another project using four of sixteen cores; load averages were 7 to 14.
The first confirmation run coincided with a slower host period (session preparation 52 s instead of about 39 s, viewer composition 116 ms instead of about 64 ms) and is kept but not comparable.
Profiled latencies include observer cost and are not the measurement of record.
Simulator-only: the real device has no host quantum, and guest work per keystroke is unchanged.
method: Tracked local_testing/physical_typing_cadence.py; fresh source-mode Desktop, physical X11 viewer, one isolated character then eighteen at 5 Hz.
Matrix at MegaPad 182ee52 (default still 8,192) with MEGAFORTH_QUANTUM_STEPS selecting 8,192/32,768/65,536/131,072; three unprofiled rounds in alternating order.
One profiled round with the archived simulator-calls-20260917 first-character observer (attribution only).
Confirmation at MegaPad a649f32 without the environment override, then two alternating default/8,192 pairs, then the canonical 22-stage physical Desktop journey.
Every run ran alone under the 900 s watchdog and 3.5 GiB aggregate-RSS stop.
